component_configuration.cpu: Apple M1 chip (8-core CPU, 7/8-core GPU, 16-core Neural Engine)
component_configuration.ram_type: Unified Memory Architecture (LPDDR4X-4266 soldered on SoC)
component_configuration.storage_interface: Soldered NAND flash on logic board (Apple controller)
component_configuration.display_resolution: 2560x1600 Retina IPS Display 400 nits P3 Wide Color

battery: Apple OEM 49.9Wh Battery Model A2389 (requires adhesive remover kit)

repairability_score.note: Demo assumption: Pentalobe exterior screws, battery secured with strong stretch-release adhesive strips, soldered unified memory and NAND flash storage prevent modular upgrades.

battery.note: Demo assumption for authorized or high-grade third-party A2389 battery replacement including specialized labor.

ssd.note: Not modularly replaceable; requires micro-soldering NAND replacement or whole logic board swap.

ram.note: Not modularly upgradeable; integrated into Apple Silicon SoC.

keyboard.note: Demo assumption for full top case with battery and Magic Keyboard assembly.

thermals.note: Demo assumption for passive heatsink thermal paste inspection (fanless design).

display.note: Demo assumption for complete Retina display assembly with TrueTone sensor calibration.

motherboard.note: Demo assumption for replacement M1 logic board.

expected_useful_life.note: Demo assumption: High SoC performance longevity and macOS software support, offset by unupgradeable storage/memory.

whole_working.note: Demo assumption for high residual value Apple M1 device in used market.

battery.note: Demo assumption for intact battery pack.

ssd.note: Soldered NAND cannot be salvaged as standard modular storage.

ram.note: Soldered SoC unified RAM cannot be salvaged independently.

display.note: Demo assumption for working OEM Retina display assembly.

chassis.note: Demo assumption for unibody aluminum chassis top/bottom shell.

motherboard_scrap.note: Demo assumption for high-density scrap logic board.

disclaimer: All pricing, lifespan and repairability metrics are structured demo assumptions, not real-time verified market quotes.
